description: Absolute docs.honua.io URLs that product code and shipped configuration hand to an operator or an agent at runtime. These are contracts, not prose cross-links: a typed refusal's remediationRef, a SCIM documentationUri, a Prometheus runbook_url. Nothing else notices when the heading underneath one is renamed, so scripts/ci/check-doc-links.py resolves every entry back to a real file and heading in docs/ and fails the gate when it cannot. Adding a new docs.honua.io URL to a scanned source root without registering it here is also an error.

sourceScan.comment: Roots swept for unregistered docs.honua.io URLs. Deliberately narrow: code and shipped config, not documentation prose. Prose cross-links between docs pages are relative and are graded by the relative-link sweep instead.

references.why: SCIM ServiceProviderConfig documentationUri. Advertised on the wire to every SCIM client that discovers the endpoint.

CapabilityUnavailableCodes.RedisRemediationRef — the remediationRef on the typed dependency-unavailable refusal (OGC API Processes problem+json, GeoServices error details, MCP error data). An agent is expected to follow this URL to learn how to make the request succeed, so a moved heading is a product defect, not a docs nit. Carried a pendingPr: 3583 marker while that branch was open; the marker was dropped when #3583 landed and the heading became real.

CapabilityUnavailableCodes.EntitlementRemediationRef — the remediationRef for a host where Redis IS configured but the Pro 'caching.redis' entitlement is absent. Same wire contract as the entry above, different remediation, and it must not silently collapse onto the Redis-optional anchor: telling an operator to configure Redis that is already configured is worse than no link.
runbook_url for HonuaDbPoolUtilizationHigh, HonuaDbPoolUtilizationCritical, HonuaDbConnectionFailures. Retargeted from the dead /operations/runbook#database-connection-issues (#3592).

runbook_url for the memory and query-latency alerts. The section's symptom table covers working-set growth, container OOM, and high latency against a healthy database. Retargeted from /operations/runbook#memory-and-gc-issues and #general-troubleshooting (#3592).

runbook_url for the error-rate alerts. Quick triage names the liveness/readiness probes and GET /api/v1/admin/observability/errors, which is the first real step. Retargeted from /operations/runbook#general-troubleshooting (#3592).
runbook_url for HonuaServiceDown. Covers scope confirmation, graceful and forced restart, targeted connection termination, maintenance posture, and escalation (#3592).

runbook_url for the upload-queue alerts. The Imports table covers rejected uploads, queue limits, and imports that never progress because Redis is absent. Retargeted from /operations/runbook#file-upload-problems (#3592).
runbook_url for HonuaRateLimitViolationsHigh. Documents the default edge-enforcement posture, the opt-in application limiter, incident triage, and safe policy changes (#3592).

runbook_url for the cache-hit-ratio alerts. The section is the canonical description of the edge/Redis/in-memory cache stack and the fallback behaviour a low hit ratio implies. Retargeted from /operations/runbook#cache-performance-problems (#3592).

runbook_url for RedisDown. The section states exactly what stops working without Redis (durable jobs, queued imports, workflow runs return 503) and what falls back safely. Retargeted from /operations/runbook#cache-performance-problems (#3592).

runbook_url for HonuaCircuitBreakerOpen. The section documents the per-service circuit breakers, their HttpResilience__ knobs, and the circuit-breaker-open troubleshooting entry. Retargeted from /operations/runbook#circuit-breaker-incidents (#3592).
runbook_url for the Redis memory and latency alerts. Covers sizing, durable-job noeviction policy, pressure response, latency budgets, and degradation order (#3592).
